title: Where Does Your Paycheck Go? Use This 50/30/20 Rule

scenes.heading: Be honest
lines: Be honest. Do you know where your paycheck actually goes?

scenes.heading: Here's why
lines: If not, that's exactly why it disappears in two weeks.

scenes.heading: The fix
lines: Use this one rule. Fifty, thirty, twenty.

scenes.heading: 50% needs
lines: Fifty percent for needs. Rent, bills, groceries.

scenes.heading: 30% wants
lines: Thirty percent for wants. Spend it with zero guilt!

scenes.heading: 20% future
lines: Twenty percent for future you. Savings and paying off debt.

scenes.heading: Real example
lines: Take home three thousand a month? That's fifteen hundred, nine hundred, and six hundred.

scenes.heading: Every dollar
lines: Three numbers. Every single dollar has a job.

scenes.heading: Full plan
lines: The full step by step guide, with what to do if your rent is too high, is on my channel.
